verdict.rationale: Supabase provisions a managed Postgres database with instant REST/GraphQL APIs, auto-generated type-safe client SDKs, and server-side access via CLI/self-hosting, backed by docs, GitHub feature list, and hands-on probes confirming CLI/local provisioning works. Community evidence corroborates real-world usage building backends with RLS-secured reads/writes from clients (SvelteKit) and servers. Missing for 10: independent benchmark of production-scale read/write reliability and a fully hands-on client-SDK read/write test beyond CLI provisioning.
